body:
| Author writes | Parsed by | Renders |
|---|---|---|
| ` ```csv <flags> ` fence | `MDXViewer.components.code` → `DataBlock` → `DataGridFromText` → `DataGrid` | interactive grid |
| ` ```tsv <flags> ` fence | same path, tab delimiter default | same |
| ` ```datagrid <flags> ` fence | same path, explicit opt-in | same |
| `<Datagrid src="…" meta="…" … />` | `MDXViewer.components.datagrid` → `DataBlock` | same, src-only (no inline data) |

A tiny remark plugin `remarkCodeMeta` copies `node.meta` onto hast as
`data-meta`, so the fence's info-string survives to the React layer.
